{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the data
print(df.info())
print('\nMissing values in body_mass_g:')
print(df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values or implausible data
print('\nSummary stats for body_mass_g:')
print(df['body_mass_g'].describe())

# Inspect the distribution of body_mass_g
print('\nTop 5 body_mass_g values:')
print(df['body_mass_g'].dropna().sort_values(ascending=False).head())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:')
print(df.duplicated().sum())"}
